wheelchair_availability: Accessibility assistance may be available at the temple, but current official information does not clearly confirm wheelchair availability at the main entrance. Confirm with temple staff before visiting. Personal mobility aids should be confirmed with temple staff regarding access restrictions.
priority_darshan: There are no paid or VIP lines. Because Chilkur Balaji treats everyone equally, there are no special senior citizen queues.
guidelines: Seniors and individuals with mild mobility constraints should plan visits on Monday through Thursday early mornings (6:00 AM – 7:30 AM) to complete their pradakshinas before peak crowd surges.
